whatIs: Landingfolio is a landing page gallery with more than 900 sites, plus a library of individual sections (hero, header, footer, testimonials, calls to action) with thousands of examples. You browse it through category tabs such as SaaS, Product or Mobile App, with a desktop or mobile view and a search for sites, sections and colors.
It's a good fit when you're about to lay out a landing page and want to see how others solve a specific block, instead of looking at full pages.
uses: Checking how other SaaS landing pages lay out the hero and pricing table before building yours.
Filtering by category, such as SaaS or Mobile App, to compare several landing pages in the same field.
Looking for testimonial sections or footers to copy as a base in Tailwind, Webflow or Figma.
caveats: Without Pro you can't filter by color or see the mobile version of the sites.
The full component archive is limited: without Pro you only see the 40 newest in each category.
Saved collections are capped at 20 sections on free accounts, and sponsored ads are mixed in with the content.
pricingNote: Annual plan for $49 or a one-time payment of $59; the free account has limits.
idealFor: Anyone laying out landing pages who wants references by section.
